messages.subject: Kingsmoor House, Leeds - draft contract and title pack
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear James,

Please find enclosed via our data room the draft contract for sale, official copies of title WYK482116, the tenancy schedule, the occupational leases and the two rent deposit deeds. CPSE replies will follow shortly. Our clients are keen to exchange by end March.

Kind regards,

Zoe Abbott
Associate | Marlowe Greaves LLP
